Two independently coded finite-field boundary rank checks are consistency checks, not the integral proof.

value.rationale: The canonical Franklin graph arises in the classical Klein-bottle six-color problem. A complete graph-specific integral homotopy classification plus its entire nontrivial 48-symmetry rational module, including an invariant line and a centrally odd irreducible three-space, gives structural topological data not inferred from graph parameters, suspension bounds, or a matching-complex calculation.
